notes.title: Happy New Years~ Update 01.01.211
notes.content:
Salutation Quantumers and Happy New Year!

A quick thank you for all the Quantumers who have come back to play both the extended endings and the Xmas special - as well as to all our new Quantumers who have joined in the recent Steam Sale - Thank you for playing Quantum Suicide and WELCOME <3 

To start the year off with a bang, I am dropping update/patch 01.01.211 :D

Thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs and errors! I am working through them all and hope to fix them all ASAP! :D

What to expect in this update:

- Information regarding softlock and unlocks!
A few players were finding the soft locks and unlocks a little confusing, so I have added screens that notify you if you have hit a soft lock (a part in a timeline that you can't progress through) as well as a notification when these soft locks have been opened (including an image of the timeline and which part has opened!)
If you like, or don't like this - I would love some feedback! :D

- 2 New CG's in the CG gallery!
I have added two CG's to the gallery: one [spoiler] when Dai is surrounded by dead bodies - this is seen in chapter 4 girl Nikolas route but didn't have a CG in the gallery - woops [/spoiler] and two [spoiler] The Ai ending of the XMAS special. The Dai image is a modified version of the other CG and so I haven't repeated it! [/spoiler]

- Fixed CG's for unlocking!
Two CG's were not unlocking, but now should be! To unlock these (if they haven't unlocked for you), you will need to replay a scene (Sorry!) - If these still don't open for you, please let me know! 
CG1: [spoiler] Ai's drawing she makes with Melody - Chapter One, spend time with Melody [/spoiler]
CG2: [spoiler] The protagonist's drawing of Kimiko -  Chapter One, spend time with Melody, and then choose to draw Kimiko [/spoiler]

- Achievement repairs!
I have attempted to fix the following achievements that have been not unlocking for some people (both in game and/or Steam). If you could please try these fixes, and if they still don't unlock, please tell me! I have tested on my end, and they work, buuuuuuuttttt we all know that isn't how development works :P

1. [spoiler] Mars is my Home Planet - Please start a new game and select to play as a male then save the game and check your achievements :D [/spoiler]

2. [spoiler] For Better or Worse. - If this has unlocked in Steam, but not in game, please start a new game and it should automatically unlock in the game achievements *fingers crossed*  [/spoiler]

3. [spoiler] One plus Two is Me? - I have made a second possible way for this to unlock! To test this achievement, please replay the Boy Kimiko route Don't Jump (after you have passed the softlocks)  [/spoiler]

4. [spoiler] Liar Liar, pants on fire - This achievement is what haunts my dreams. Please replay the prologue, ensuring to lie to Sora and Vlad and then if you are a girl, partner with Shizuka and Katashi, and if you are a boy, partner with the Vogels. This should now unlock and sync. [/spoiler]

If you are missing any of the above achievements and they still don't unlock (either in Steam or in-game), please let me know so I can attempt to try again and fix for you! :D

- Achievement added!
A new achievement has been added! If you want to know what it is and where to get it, here it is:
[spoiler] Heads I win, Tails you lose - Play scissors paper rock with Shizuka and no matter what happens, she claims she wins (even when she clearly doesn't!) - to unlock this achievement, you will need to speak with Shizuka on day 1 of Chapter 2 (Girl - Shizuka and Yoshiki Route)  [/spoiler]

Further repairs include:

- The multitude of Kimiko's that decided to appear when speaking about the black hole! (There is now only one!)

- About 25 grammatical and spelling errors that have been reported!

What I am working on: (I haven't forgotten these reports, promise!)

- VA repairs (trying to get correct lines together to fix the few mistakes in English that have been reported! 
- A mishap happening when speaking with Nikolas and Beatrix about clues. 
- More transition inclusions
- Fixing the skip button for Deletion Game explanations 

(If I have forgotten something I need to fix, feel free to remind me here! My brain is a bit fried :P)

Okay! Well that is all I have fixed and hope you all enjoy the rest of your NEW YEARS DAY and your holidays :D

<3 MoltenCherry!

P.S. - If you do like Quantum Suicide and haven't left a review, please do! :D I reeeeeaaaallly would like to get to 80% positive on Steam! Then, if I dai any time soon, I can dai happy :P

notes.title: Quantum Suicide extended romantic endings are now live~!
notes.content:
Salutation Quantumers!

I hope everyone is having a wonderful December and are gearing up for the holiday period (well, the best you can given the ongoing pandemic!)

I am happy to announce that I have updated the game to contain some extra content! Here is the list of the new inclusions: (For those who don't want spoilers - all romantic endings in the main timeline have been extended)

[spoiler] Kimiko romance endings - both boy (before credits) and girl routes (after credits) [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Katashi romance endings - both boy and girl routes [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Yoshiki romance ending - boy route [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Nikolas romance ending - girl route [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Shizuka romance ending - boy route [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Beatrix romance ending - girl route [/spoiler]

And small inclusions that aren't romantic endings:

[spoiler] Male Me? explanation of Quantum Suicide and Immortality (male Kimiko route) [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Male Me? explanation of his actions in the girl route timeline (Kimiko route) [/spoiler]

These are all in English with English VA at the present time! The Japanese is in the process of being translated and once that is done, we can get the Japanese VA to record these sections as well :)

As far as ENG VA goes, all that is remaining to put in is: [spoiler] Male Me [/spoiler], [spoiler] MC VA [/spoiler], PA system and about 10 more Dai lines that are being recorded now :)

I know they aren't long extensions - but hopefully, this will leave you all with a warmer and fuzzier feeling in your chests after working so hard to reach the romantic endings! 

I have also included a patch for the following fixes:
- Sora's ENG VA that was out in the prologue has now been repaired.
- Shizuka's ENG VA that was too long in chap 1 has now been repaired.
- Missing Shizuka sprite in chap 1 has now been repaired.
- VA mix up with Vladimir and the protagonist has now been repaired.
- References to Beatrix in one version of the Deletion Game in chapter 4 has been changed to Nikolas (as it should have been!)

That's it from me at the moment Quantumers!

<3 MoltenCherry

P.S - Stay tuned for some good news over the Xmas holidays :D

notes.title: Quantum Suicide update 23.10.01 is here!? What's inside it!?
notes.content:
Good Evening Quantumers!

I hope you are all having a wonderful evening/day! 

On to the good stuff straight away! The new update includes:

[b]- Updated VA files[/b] (Now with more Nikolas, Melody, Katashi, Ai and Dai!) - it should be getting increasingly difficult to find non - voiced sections! By my count, over the entire game, there should be only about 50 left (that I am in the process of fixing :D)

[b]- More Save Slots Added! [/b]
I heard you all ask for more save files! So now you can have them! The save files have been increased from 6 to 18 slots!! Many saves, much wow!

[b]- Added "The next day. . ." sequences[/b] to indicate a change of day (this doesn't show when chapter screen is shown). Hopefully this makes it clearer - and I would love your feedback on them! 

[b]- In game achievement[/b] [spoiler] For better or worse [/spoiler] should now unlock in game when achieved, not just in Steam! 

[b]- A Melody/Ai loop[/b] that was occurring in Chapter 1 (boy route) has now been rectified and you are all free from that loop hell! :D

[b]- In game sound effects[/b] are starting to be added based on feedback! Currently, these include watch sounds, airlocks sounds and some death sounds~ ohhhhhhhh~ (I am working on bringing you more!)

[b]- Reported spelling mistakes[/b] and sprites have been corrected! (Except for the one about the back hole - it was just too funny to fix :D

The updated/extended endings for romance endings are estimated for early November :) Testing is about to start on them~ 

Until next update!

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: Quantum Suicide Patch 11.10.01!
notes.content:
Salutation Quantumers!

Thank you for your ongoing patience and support!! <3

Here are the changes in the most recent patch:

- Bidding Wars has been re-vamped!
[spoiler] Images now have the scores on the left, rather than right so not be blocked by UI [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Images have been added to include the score of each round [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Final rounds now show images and scores before executions! [/spoiler]

I am pretty sure it is now working well (as in logically) as well as opening all timeline sections, however, I did have to make over 400 images (which is why this took so long) - and so if I have added something wrong *shakes angry fist at maths*, please tell me and I will replace that score board ASAP! :D

- MORE VA!! (So close to being finished!)
To give you an idea, I am now waiting on only about 100 more VA lines (out of 20,000) and then each line should be complete! I do apologies for the occasional awkward silence, but I do hope they are far and between and don't ruin your experience! :D

- Achievement [spoiler] For Better or Worse [/spoiler] should be opening now in game, if not, please let me know as I can only test on my side . . . and I know it sometimes lies to me :P

- Computer menu returning to game rather than Deletion Game menu is now fixed! :D

Please make sure you are updating your game :) For some people it isn't automatically updating (T . T) To be sure, please exit Steam and then reopen - if it has a patch, it will tell you :D

On to other news:

I am currently working on making extended endings for the romance endings as well as a better and more thorough explanation for [spoiler] how the pocket watch works and where and why other versions of yourself come from[/spoiler] and hope to have these patched in ASAP!! In order to do so, I have started a Patreon to help fund the small bits and pieces I need (such as VA and translations)~

If you want to support me further (cause being here is already awesome!), please check out my Patreon here:  [url=https://www.patreon.com/CCCN]Patreon Page [/url]

Also, we have a discord channel if you wanted to join us! Become ONE OF US, ONE OF US! 
[url=https://discord.gg/ZZbMs3a]Discord Channel[/url]

Oh! Oh! And before I forget, if you have enjoyed the game, please leave a review! I know it takes time and effort but I would reeeeeeaaally appreciate it <3 Legit, it will make my day! :D

Well, that is all from me at this point!! I will continue to work on the up and coming improvements!! 

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: New Small Patch~
notes.content:
Salutations Quantumers!

Before getting into the patch notes, I really want to thank everyone who has been leaving feedback and reviews! Not only do I have plenty to work with moving forwards, but we are also officially mostly positive in reviews!! GO TEAM! 
*Team being all of you of course, I am but one person! You are all on the team now - woot team!*

I am pleased to let you know that patch 22.9.001 is now live and contains the following:

- Updated Keyboard Entry [spoiler] specifically after boot up preference. The keyboard is no longer pre-filled to avoid confusion with putting in correct names  [/spoiler]

- Before Keyboard entries, a notice that the keyboard is case sensitive and lower case is required. A quick sorry to everyone how beat their head against the table trying the correct passwords with capitals!

- Timeline updates to include:
[spoiler] The ability to unlock a part of the Girl Kimi Route which soft locks after you finish the game - you should be able to play through this even after you have jumped and practically saved the universe! [/spoiler]

- [spoiler] All Bidding War Protagonist deaths should now be accessible! You need to do the right combination - but the same combination will get you killed across all 6 timeline options - this is: 1D, 2C, 3B [/spoiler]

- Deletion Game Videos should no longer play by accident when you attempt to leave the in-game tablet menu.

- [spoiler] The issues around not lying to Sora, but it believing you have should be fixed! [/spoiler]

- More VA repaired! At the rate I am getting through the errors, I hope to have all VA in perfect working form by the Weekend!

- The Kimiko on the other team comment should FINALLY BE DEAD! *pleeeease be dead!*

If any problems still happen (especially those above!) please don't hesitate to tell me :D I test them all myself before patching, but sometimes funky things happen on one end and not on mine~ But I will fix as fast as I can! 

<3 MoltenCherry

Salutation Quantumers :)

Thank you all for taking the time to play Quantum Suicide, and to read this update!

Sorry it is so short, but fixing the two achievements that weren't triggering took MUCH MUCH longer to fix than first anticipated.

notes.title: Major Patch :)
notes.content:
Salutation Quantumers!

Thank you for your continued patience and support! I really am excited to keep working with your feedback to make this as enjoyable as possible :D
There will be more patching to come! So if the problem isn't fixed yet, it will be :)

<Here are the patch notes for 14.9.001>

- English VA has been re-instated. (Thank you to everyone who flagged this!)
   Unfortunately, some of my voice files corrupted and will be patched back in in the next coming day or
